title: We Are Ordered to Help and Protect the Weak
body:
(Mawlana Shaykh stands)
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, `Azeez Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Kareem Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Subhaan Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Sultaan Allah
Subhaan sen, Sultaan sen! Anta Subhaan, anta Sultaan! Zid habeebika yaa Rabbi 'l-`Alameen,`izzan wa
sharafan nooran wa surooran, wa ridwaanan wa sultaana. Zid wa baarik saair al-anbiya wa 'l-mursaleen wa
man tabi`ahum bi ihsaan ila Yawmi 'd-Deen. Allahuma 'ghfir lanaa wa 'rhamnaa wa toob `alaynaa wa 'hdinaa
wa 'sqinaa wa 'slih shaa'nana wa shaa'na 'l-muslimeen. Thumma salaam `alaa Saahibi 'z-Zamaan. Thumma
as-salaatu wa 's-salaam `alaa Saahib az-Zamaan wa `alaa Qutb az-Zamaan wa `alaa a'immatuna fi turuqu 'l`aliyya amidahum, yaa Rabbee bi madadin khaas, yaa Rabbana! (Mawlana Shaykh sits)
Eyyyy, hayyyyyy, eyyyyy, hayyyyyy
Eyyyy, hayyyyyy, eyyyyy, hayyyyyy

A`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani 'r-rajeem. Yaa RijaalAllah!
O Heavenly Ones! O Holy Ones! O Clean Ones! Send us from your heavenly support. We are weak ones,
asking in this holy month more heavenly support for winning over our egos. We are trying to take away our
egos’ dirtiness. Our egos are working in dirtiness. Our egos are never asking to be clean ones, but always
asking for dirtiness. May Allah send His heavenly cleanliness to His weak servants. Really, O our attenders,
we are not weak ones because who is granted to say, Bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'r-Raheem, is never going to be a
weak one! That is such a big grant that no one can reach the limits of that grant. Astaghfirullah. Allah
Almighty is saying, asta'eedhu billah (Mawlana Shaykh stands)
•••••••• •••••••••• ••••••••
Wa khuliq al-insaanu da’eefa. Man is created weak. (4:28)
(Mawlana Shaykh sits) SadaqAllahu 'l-`Adheem.
O our Attenders! Don't be heedless ones. Wake up, particularly Salafi `ulamas who are giving such a title for
themselves that it shows they think they are not weak ones! Yes, they say, "We are `ulamas," and yet you are
weak ones. Don't forget that you are a weak Creation. You may use a title, but mostly titles are giving people
an idea that they are important, and they say, "We are something, we are important ones! How can we accept
that we are weak ones?"
Shaytan is saying to them, "Use a title that removes your weak status."
And Allah Almighty is saying, wa khuliq al-insaanu da`eefa. SubhaanAllah! He is not saying, khalaqtu alinsaan da`eefa, but He is saying wa khuliq al-insaanu da`eefa. Because Allah Almighty is saying, (Mawlana
Shaykh stands)
•••••• ••••••• ••• •••••••• •••••••••
innee ja`ilun fi 'l-ardi khaleefah. I am appointing a deputy on Earth. (2:30)
Khalifah is chief, so how is he going to be weak? (Mawlana Shaykh sits) Feehee nazar. They are asking me to
ask Salafi `ulamas their opinion. Do you say that insaan is created da`eef? And ayatul-kareemah is saying,
innee ja`ilun fi 'l-ardi khaleefah. khaleefah is never, never, never showing any sign of weakness.

SubhaanAllahi 'l-`Aliyyu 'l-`Adheem. Feehee nazar. We must ponder it. Insaan, Man, is created khuliq alinsaanu da`eefa. One meaning is coming now, that insaan was born so weak, as a newborn child is so weak,
then his physical being is getting powerful, more powerful, more powerful, and he is standing up. Ajaa`ib.
Wa khuliq al-insaanu da`eefa. First, Creation is from sperms of its dad, and this very weak thing makes a
human being? When its creation is going to be perfect and complete, then dressing on him a dress, innee
ja`ilun fi 'l-ardi khaleefah, to be Allah Almighty's deputy on Earth. That small one that is so weak can't be a
khaleefah. Then, "We are making and giving to him what he needs from power." He is physically getting
powerful and with his spirituality he is taking an honor to be deputy. Our physical being can't carry that
honor, but our spiritual being can carry that great, grand honor, yes!
We are saying "weak servants." Do our `ulamas know what Shari`atullah is ordering? Say what the holy
Shari`ah is ordering to you, O `ulamas! And say to kings or sultans what is holy Shari`ah's order. Say! Don't
you know that Allah Almighty is ordering, "Help weak ones!" That is an order! When Allah Almighty is
saying, khuliq al-insaanu da`eefa, first of all, that command is coming to that child's father and mother to
look after that weak one with high care. I am sorry to say that now, in the 21st century, people are bringing
that baby at three days or one week, they are bringing that weak one to the door of churches, or orphanage
doors, or city councils’ doors, saying, “We reached the high point of civilization,” but they are liars! The holy
command of Allah Almighty is, “Help weak ones!”
That is why Allah Almighty is saying, wa khuliq al-insaanu da`eefa. It means, "Take the most care of the new
Creation." It is the first heavenly command to kings, queens, umaraa, princes, shaykhs, rich ones, presidents,
governments, and to all who have been granted power. Look after that helpless creature, that weak newborn
that is thrown away! Take care of weak ones because they have been created weak and can't do anything.
Take the highest care of those small ones!
Where is civilization? Doctors are cutting women (with Caesarian deliveries) and taking that new child `ajiz,
weak ones, from the wombs of women and throwing them away. Thousands of such things are happening
daily. And therefore, the Lord of Heavens is angry with people on Earth. Therefore, He is sending floods,
fires, volcanoes, earthquakes, and unknown diseases as a punishment to make them weak, to taste the
bitterness of weakness!

O People! Who are living from east to west, Islam is coming and living with rahmah, mercy! If there is no
mercy, there is no Islam!
O Mankind! Take care of weak ones everywhere, that you are living and so proud that you reached the top
point of civilization in the 21st century!
O Salafi `ulamas! Don't you know the holy hadith of the Seal of Prophets (s): (Mawlana Shaykh stands)
•••••• •• •• ••••• •••••• •• •• ••••••
Irham man fi 'l-ard yarhamakum man fi 's-sama. Have mercy to those on Earth and the One in Heavens will
have mercy on you.
Is this not a hadeeth; don't you know it? Where is your rahmah and your pity for people? You are looking
only for your egoistic pleasures. (Mawlana Shaykh sits) And people from east to west, from north to south,
billions of people are in the worst condition and no one is giving their pity for those poor people, for those
weak creatures! Where we are living now, every day they are making me shout at those people who are
saying, "We are Salafi `ulamas. We are Wahhabi `ulamas. We are doctors. We are Muslim authorities." That
hadeeth must be written everywhere in golden letters: Irham man fi'l-ard yarhamakum man fi's-sama, "Give
your pity to weak ones and needy ones and poor ones." Help them, then the Lord of Heavens will give you
from His endless Mercy Oceans! If not, then ghadabullah, anger of the Lord of Heavens, will approach you,
just as heavenly anger reached to the armies of Nimrod, taking them away! (Mawlana Shaykh stands)
••••• •••••• ••••• ••••••• •••••••••
Wa maa dhaalika `ala 'Llahi bi-`azeez. That is not at all difficult for Allah, Who has no equal. (14:20, 35:17)
Is this true, or not?! What do you think, O `ulamas? Maa dhaalika `ala 'Llahi bi-`azeez. Allah Almighty, Who
has qaadiran mutlaq, Absolute Power, "I can do anything, and if you do not change your way, I will reach you
with My heavenly anger!" (Mawlana Shaykh sits)
O People! This is a holy month and Allah Almighty ordered you to give to poor people. Don’t wait for poor
people to come to you begging. No, you must reach out to them. That is real honor for you. Someone was
saying about a person who was asking for charity from him, "Daily they are coming to ask, and we are giving

our zakaat and sadaqah, but people are coming without end!”
That person was asking, “What are you giving from zakaat? You don’t know? I would like to hear from you.”
“We are calculating our gold and our riches; from 40, we are taking one and giving for the sake of Allah to
poor people (i.e., one-fortieth of their wealth)."
The one who asked was very angry, saying, "You are not ashamed to give for Allah one from 40 and keeping
39 for yourself? Ptuu! Spit on you and your dishonored position!"
People now are in such a way. one person said, “Yaa Shaykh, leave them! If they are giving one from 40, it is
enough. Don't quarrel with them.” But they are not giving even one from 40. And we are saying to those
people, you are giving to the poor one from 40 and keeping 39 for yourself? One for Allah? How are you
understanding Shari`atullah or Allah's Mercy for His creatures? You must say, "O my Lord! For You, all is for
giving." How can you find people like this, in such a way? Shame on them! Shame! Where are those people
who say, "O my Lord! I am taking one for myself and giving 39 for You." How can you find those people?
O Salafi `ulamas, you are rich people! Give for the sake of your Lord! May Allah forgive us.
O People! Allah Almighty is saying, "I must test My servants, how they are with Me, and how they are with
dunya. What are they preparing for their dunya and what for Mawla? I must test and try My servants." And
all holy ones, awliyaullah, are saying, “All those people are never passing from their lowest level up, not even
one level.”
O Allah Almighty! Give us to taste the sweetness of Shari'ah! Send us someone from Your good people, from
Your good servants, to teach us to live as You like. And may Allah forgive us for the honor of Your most
beloved one (Mawlana Shaykh stands), and change us from bad ones to good ones, for the honor of the Seal
of Prophets (s). (Mawlana Shaykh sits).
Fatihah.
(Mawlana Shaykh sings.)

Dome dome, dome dome, Dome dome, dome dome 4x
Shaytan and his followers are never happy with such an addressing. They are very angry, and I am asking that
their anger kills them!
(40 minutes) (860 viewers) Today is Sunday. May Allah forgive us.
(Mawlana Shaykh prays two raka`at Salaat ash-Shukr.)
(Mawlana Shaykh speaks with Hajjah Naziha and Shaykh Hisham Effendi on the phone.)
